Nim Basics

A quick introduction to Nim programming.

Variables

let x = 10      # immutable
var y = 20      # mutable
const z = 30    # compile-time constant

Procedures

proc greet(name: string): string =
  "Hello, " & name & "!"

Resources

The official manual lives at https://nim-lang.org/docs/manual.html and the forum is at https://forum.nim-lang.org. See also the discussion of xhttps://not-a-link.example (glued to a word, stays plain text), or the Nim repository written as a markdown link.
